about: The most script and style files web/index.html may load, and their bytes as stored and gzipped (tools/shell_budget.py, run by make check). `files` is the count today: a new file in the shell raises it in the same pull request. The byte budgets leave about 5 % over the size measured when they were set (2026-11-20: 105 files, 2858060 bytes, 824626 gzipped); a pull request that needs more raises them, so the raise shows in its diff (context/performance.md, item 15).
